_about: Post-extraction corrections from the independent audit of 30 October 2026. Applied by scripts/apply_corrections.py after merging. Each patch replaces the named fields; 'check.*' keys patch inside check.

execution.notes: Patterns run on one paragraph at a time (DOCX paragraph or labelled-markdown line). Anchored patterns use (?m). The runner must enforce `scope` (body, heading, caption, table, footnote, reference ...) and mask quotations first (REF-12_3_3-006).
execution.input: DOCX run text is the reference input: it keeps non-breaking spaces, superscripts and italics. On markdown or plain text, rules whose check.requires includes 'nbsp' or 'formatting' are skipped and listed as not checked in the receipt.
execution.apply_policy: Calibration phase: every finding is reported as Verify, whatever its action. A rule is promoted to auto-apply only after it has run on at least three real manuscripts with no false positive; record that in calibration.status. Until then `action: Apply` means 'unambiguous once the editor has confirmed the hit'.

check.notes: Judgement: replace an imprecise verb (do, make, get, enhance) only where a more precise verb fits; never as a word swap.

WRT-3_3_2-007.check.notes: Table 3.2 lists alternatives (Chair or head; humanity or human race; artificial, manufactured or synthetic; human resources, labour force, personnel, workers or workforce). The editor picks the one that fits.

ABB-7-019.check.notes: Markdown heading hashes are not abbreviations of number.

ABB-7-018.check.notes: The guide itself uses e.g. outside parentheses; flag only clusters (more than about one per paragraph) for the editor.

ABB-7-013.check.notes: Skip headings written entirely in capitals (a design choice), roman numerals and NOCS names that contain capitals (Hong Kong SAR). Report under WRT-3_5-003 for document titles.

check.notes: Document-level: report once if numbered subheadings are used and nothing cross-refers to them.

NUM-10-011.check.notes: The unspaced 5+ digit alternative also hits article numbers (World Development, 142: 105455), file names and URLs; skip references and URLs.

PUN-5_8-008.check.notes: Exclude official terms such as least developed countries (Appendix 2).
